title: Aggregators, research listings and official forums
description: Hacker News, arXiv category listings, Discourse forums for Godot, Blender, Hugging Face and others, and the Kagi Small Web feed. Patterns (arXiv, Discourse, hnrss) come from each platform's documentation found in search results.

items.title: Hacker News front page (official RSS)
items.summary: Official RSS of the Hacker News front page.
items.licence: Y Combinator / submitters' terms; linked articles keep their own rights
items.notes: Consistently reported as the official front-page feed in search results.

items.title: hnrss.org front page
items.summary: Community-run Hacker News feed service: front page with points and comment links.
items.licence: Third-party service; HN content terms apply
items.notes: hnrss.org is community-maintained, not run by Y Combinator.

items.title: hnrss.org Show HN
items.summary: Show HN launches: new tools and projects, often agent and media tools.
items.licence: Third-party service; HN content terms apply

items.title: hnrss.org keyword feed: Godot OR Blender
items.summary: Newest HN submissions matching Godot or Blender; the q parameter takes OR-joined keywords, so the same pattern works for any watchlist topic.
items.licence: Third-party service; HN content terms apply
items.notes: Keyword pattern newest?q=KEYWORD1+OR+KEYWORD2 documented in search results.

items.title: Kagi Small Web feed
items.summary: Recent posts from personal blogs in the Kagi Small Web index.
items.licence: Posts belong to their authors
items.notes: URL published in the kagisearch/smallweb README (fetched from GitHub 2026-10-10).

items.title: Kagi Small Web OPML
items.summary: OPML of the sites behind the Kagi Small Web feed; import into a reader or filter by keyword.
items.licence: Index list is MIT (kagisearch/smallweb); posts belong to their authors
items.notes: URL published in the kagisearch/smallweb README (fetched from GitHub 2026-10-10).

items.title: arXiv cs.AI: Artificial Intelligence (daily listing)
items.summary: New AI papers: agents, planning, reasoning.
items.licence: arXiv metadata; each paper has its own licence
items.notes: URL pattern from arXiv's official RSS help page (info.arxiv.org/help/rss.html), found in search results: append the category to https://rss.arxiv.org/rss/ (or /atom/); combine categories with '+'. Feeds update daily around midnight US Eastern, with no weekend announcements.
cautions: Review arXiv's Terms of Use for APIs before automated use; poll once a day after the announcement, not more.
Listings are preprints, not peer-reviewed; check versions and licences (many are arXiv's non-exclusive licence, not CC) before reusing figures.
